app.name: Readi
app.tagline: Practise tech interviews with an AI interviewer and get honest, specific feedback.

landing.heading: Walk into your next tech interview ready.

features.interviewer: Realistic mock interviews that ask follow-up questions.
features.feedback: Rubric-based feedback that quotes what you actually said.
features.local: Built for Nigerian conditions: mobile-first, light on data, priced in Naira.

v1.title: Process my voice during interviews
v1.body: Your speech is converted to text by our speech-recognition provider so the AI interviewer can respond and give feedback.

v1.title: Keep recordings of my interviews
v1.body: Recordings are stored for 30 days so you can listen back, then deleted automatically.

v1.title: Camera coaching
v1.body: Eye contact and posture are analysed on your device. Video never leaves your device; only numbers are sent.

v1.title: Product news and tips
v1.body: Occasional emails about new features and interview tips. Unsubscribe at any time.

diagnostic.title: Start with a diagnostic interview
diagnostic.body: A 15-minute mixed interview that shows where you are today and builds your first study plan.
diagnostic.note: The diagnostic interview arrives in the next update. Your profile is ready for it.

admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Platform administration. Content management arrives in Milestone M2.
